Railway RRB ALP Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has issued updates regarding the Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) recruitment drive under notification CEN – 01/2026. According to the reported details, candidates can access their exam city information and download hall tickets through the official regional portals ahead of the upcoming computer-based examinations.

Applicants are advised to verify all notifications directly via official channels rather than relying solely on third-party aggregators.

Key Dates and Schedule

  • Issuing Authority: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
  • Notification ID: CEN – 01/2026
  • Post Name: Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP)
  • Last Date to Submit Application: 15 May 2026 (Historical/Closed)
  • Exam City Details Availability: 24 October 2026
  • Admit Card Availability: 30 October 2026
  • Examination Dates: 03 – 05 November 2026

Eligibility and Qualifications

  • Educational Requirements: Candidates must have passed 10th grade along with an ITI certificate in the relevant trade, or hold a Diploma/Degree in Engineering in the respective discipline.
  • Age Limit: Age relaxation is applicable as per standard railway regulations.
  • Zone-Wise Eligibility: Aspirants should consult the official regional notification for specific zone-wise breakdowns.

Application Fees and Refund Structure

  • Standard Fee: Not specified for initial unreserved submissions beyond refund mentions.
  • SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Serviceman Candidates: ₹250/-
  • Fee Refund Policy: Reported claims indicate that ₹400 will be refunded to General/OBC candidates and ₹250 to other eligible categories after they formally appear in the Stage I examination. Payment can be processed online via debit card, credit card, internet banking, IMPS, or mobile wallets.

Selection Stages

  1. First Stage Computer-Based Test (CBT-1)
  2. Subsequent stages as outlined in the official notification (such as CBT-2, Aptitude Test where applicable)
  3. Document Verification
  4. Medical Examination

How to Verify and Download Admit Cards

To check exam city details or download admit cards, candidates should follow these steps:

  • Visit the official website of your respective regional Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) or the central portal at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
  • Navigate to the CEN 01/2026 – Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) section.
  • Access the link for Exam City Details or Admit Card login.
  • Enter credentials such as Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth.
  • Save and print the admit card along with the exam city notice for future reference.

*Note: Candidates should independently cross-check all dates, timings, and reporting instructions directly from official RRB notifications.*
